name: master-ball
effect: Catches a wild Pokémon every time.
effect_full: Used in battle : Catches a wild Pokémon without fail. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.
flavor: The best Poké Ball with the ultimate level of performance. With it, you will catch any wild Pokémon without fail.

name: ultra-ball
effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon.  Success rate is 2×.
effect_full: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon, using a catch rate of 2×. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.
flavor: An ultra-high-performance Poké Ball that provides a higher success rate for catching Pokémon than a Great Ball.

name: great-ball
effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon.  Success rate is 1.5×.
effect_full: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon, using a catch rate of 1.5×. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.
flavor: A good, high-performance Poké Ball that provides a higher success rate for catching Pokémon than a standard Poké Ball.

name: poke-ball
effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon.
effect_full: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon, using a catch rate of 1×. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.
flavor: A device for catching wild Pokémon. It’s thrown like a ball at a Pokémon, comfortably encapsulating its target.

name: safari-ball
effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon in the Great Marsh or Safari Zone.  Success rate is 1.5×.
effect_full: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon, using a catch rate of 1.5×. This item can only be used in the Great Marsh or Safari Zone.
flavor: A special Poké Ball that was used in the Safari Zone in the Kanto region and in the Great Marsh in the Sinnoh region.

name: net-ball
effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon.  Success rate is 3× for water and bug Pokémon.
effect_full: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon. If the wild Pokémon is Water- or Bug-type, this ball has a catch rate of 3×. Otherwise, it has a catch rate of 1×. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.
flavor: A somewhat different Poké Ball that is more effective when attempting to catch Water- or Bug-type Pokémon.

name: dive-ball
effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon. Success rate is 3.5× when underwater, fishing, or surfing.
effect_full: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon. If the wild Pokémon was encountered by surfing or fishing, this ball has a catch rate of 3.5×. Otherwise, it has a catch rate of 1×. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.
flavor: A somewhat different Poké Ball that works especially well when catching Pokémon that live underwater.

name: nest-ball
effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon.  Success rate is 3.9× for level 1 Pokémon, and drops steadily to 1× at level 30.
effect_full: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon. Has a catch rate of given by `(40 - level) / 10`, where `level` is the wild Pokémon’s level, to a maximum of 3.9× for level 1 Pokémon. If the wild Pokémon’s level is higher than 30, this ball has a catch rate of 1×. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.
flavor: A somewhat different Poké Ball that becomes more effective the lower the level of the wild Pokémon.

name: repeat-ball
effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon.  Success rate is 3× for previously-caught Pokémon.
effect_full: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon. If the wild Pokémon’s species is marked as caught in the trainer’s Pokédex, this ball has a catch rate of 3×. Otherwise, it has a catch rate of 1×. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.
flavor: A somewhat different Poké Ball that works especially well on a Pokémon species that has been caught before.

name: timer-ball
effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon. Success rate increases by 0.1× (Gen V: 0.3×) every turn, to a max of 4×.
effect_full: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon. Has a catch rate of 1.1× on the first turn of the battle and increases by 0.1× every turn, to a maximum of 4× on turn 30. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.
flavor: A somewhat different Poké Ball that becomes progressively more effective at catching Pokémon the more turns that are taken in battle.

name: luxury-ball
effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon.  Caught Pokémon start with 200 happiness.
effect_full: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon, using a catch rate of 1×. Whenever the caught Pokémon’s happiness increases, it increases by one extra point. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.
flavor: A particularly comfortable Poké Ball that makes a wild Pokémon quickly grow friendlier after being caught.

name: premier-ball
effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon.
effect_full: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon, using a catch rate of 1×. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.
flavor: A somewhat rare Poké Ball that was made as a commemorative item used to celebrate an event of some sort.

name: dusk-ball
effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon.  Success rate is 3.5× at night and in caves.
effect_full: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon. If it’s currently nighttime or the wild Pokémon was encountered while walking in a cave, this ball has a catch rate of 3.5×. Otherwise, it has a catch rate of 1×. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.
flavor: A somewhat different Poké Ball that makes it easier to catch wild Pokémon at night or in dark places such as caves.

name: heal-ball
effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon.  Caught Pokémon are immediately healed.
effect_full: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon, using a catch rate of 1×. The caught Pokémon’s HP is immediately restored, PP for all its moves is restored, and any status ailment is cured. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.
flavor: A remedial Poké Ball that restores the HP of a Pokémon caught with it and eliminates any status conditions.

name: quick-ball
effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon. Success rate is 4× (Gen V: 5×), but only on the first turn.
effect_full: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon, using a catch rate of 4× on the first turn of a battle, but 1× any other time. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.
flavor: A somewhat different Poké Ball that has a more successful catch rate if used at the start of a wild encounter.

name: cherish-ball
effect: Tries to catch a wild Pokémon.
effect_full: Used in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon, using a catch rate of 1×. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost.
flavor: A quite rare Poké Ball that has been crafted in order to commemorate a special occasion of some sort.

name: white-herb
effect: Held: Resets all lowered stats to normal at end of turn. Consumed after use.

name: macho-brace
effect: Held: Holder gains double effort values from battles, but has halved Speed in battle.
effect_full: Held : When the holder would gain effort due to battle, it gains double that effort instead. Held in battle : Holder has half its Speed.
flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This stiff, heavy brace helps Pokémon grow strong but cuts Speed in battle.

name: exp-share
effect: Held: Half the experience from a battle is split between Pokémon holding this item.
effect_full: Held : Experience is split across two groups: Pokémon who participated in battle, and Pokémon holding this item. Each Pokémon earns experience as though it had battled alone, divided by the number of Pokémon in its group, then divided by the number of groups. Pokémon holding this item who also participated in battle effectively earn experience twice. Fainted Pokémon never earn experience, and empty groups are ignored; thus, if a single Pokémon is holding this item and the only Pokémon who battled faints from Explosion, the holder will gain full experience.
flavor: Turning on this special device will allow all the Pokémon on your team to receive Exp. Points from battles.

name: quick-claw
effect: Held: Holder has a 3/16 (18.75%) chance to move first.
effect_full: Held in battle : Whenever the holder attempts to use a move, it has a 3/16 chance to act first among moves with the same priority. If multiple Pokémon have this effect at the same time, Speed is the tie-breaker as normal, but the effect of Trick Room is ignored.
flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This light, sharp claw lets the bearer move first occasionally.

name: soothe-bell
effect: Held: Doubles the happiness earned by the holder.
effect_full: Held : When the holder would earn happiness for any reason, it earns twice that amount instead.
flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The comforting chime of this bell calms the holder, making it friendly.

name: mental-herb
effect: Held: Consumed to cure infatuation. Gen V: Also removes Taunt, Encore, Torment, Disable, and Cursed Body.
effect_full: Held in battle : When the holder is attracted, it consumes this item to cure the attraction.
flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. The holder shakes off move-binding effects to move freely. It can be used only once.

name: choice-band
effect: Held: Increases Attack by 50%, but restricts the holder to only one move.
effect_full: Held in battle : Holder has 1.5× its Attack. When the holder attempts to use a move, all its other moves are disabled until it leaves battle or loses this item. The restriction ends even if this item is swapped for another Choice item via Trick or Switcheroo.
flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This curious headband boosts Attack but only allows the use of one move.

name: kings-rock
effect: Held: Damaging moves gain a 10% chance to make their target flinch. Traded on a Poliwhirl: Holder evolves into Politoed. Traded on a Slowpoke: Holder evolves into Slowking.
effect_full: Held in battle : Holder’s damaging moves have a 10% chance to make their target flinch. This chance applies independently to each hit of a multi-hit move. This item’s chance is rolled independently of any other move effects; e.g., a move with a 30% chance to flinch normally will have a 37% total chance to flinch when used with this item, because 3% of the time, both effects activate. Held by Poliwhirl or Slowbro : Holder evolves into Politoed or Slowking, respectively, when traded.
flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. When the holder successfully inflicts damage, the target may also flinch.

flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It doubles any prize money received if the holding Pokémon joins a battle.

effect: Held: Inflicts Toxic on the holder at the end of the turn. Activates after Poison damage would occur.

flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It’s a bizarre orb that will badly poison the holder during battle.

name: flame-orb

effect_full: Held: Burns the holder at the end of each turn.

effect: Held: Consectutive uses of the same attack have a cumulative damage boost of 10%. Maximum 100% boost.

flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It boosts moves used consecutively but only until a different move is used.

name: iron-ball
effect: Held: Holder’s Speed is halved. Negates all Ground-type immunities, and makes Flying-types take neutral damage from Ground-type moves. Arena Trap. Spikes, and Toxic Spikes affect the holder.
effect_full: Held: Decreases the holder’s Speed by 50%. If the holder is Flying or has Levitate, it takes regular damage from Ground attacks and is suspectible to Spikes and Toxic Spikes.
flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It lowers Speed and allows Ground-type moves to hit Flying types and holders that are levitating.

name: lagging-tail
effect: Held: Holder moves last in its priority bracket.
effect_full: Held: The holder will go last within its move’s priority bracket, regardless of Speed. If multiple Pokémon within the same priority bracket are subject to this effect, the slower Pokémon will go first. The holder will move after Pokémon with Stall. If the holder has Stall, Stall is ignored. This item ignores Trick Room.
flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It is tremendously heavy and makes the holder move slower than usual.

name: destiny-knot
effect: Held: Infatuates opposing Pokémon when holder is inflicted with infatuation.
effect_full: Held: When the holder becomes Attracted, the Pokémon it is Attracted to becomes Attracted back.
flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. If the holder becomes infatuated, the opposing Pokémon will be, too.

name: black-sludge
effect: Held: Poison-type holder recovers 1/16 (6.25%) max HP each turn. Non-Poison-Types take 1/8 (12.5%) max HP damage.
effect_full: Held: If the holder is Poison-type, restores 1/16 max HP at the end of each turn. Otherwise, damages the holder by 1/16 its max HP at the end of each turn.
flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It gradually restores HP to Poison-type Pokémon. It damages any other type.

name: icy-rock
effect: Held: Hail by the holder lasts 8 rounds instead of 5.
effect_full: Held: The holder’s Hail will create a hailstorm lasting for eight turns rather than five. As this item affects the move rather than the weather itself, the effect is not lost if the holder leaves battle or drops this item.
flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It extends the duration of the move Hail when used by the holder.

name: smooth-rock
effect: Held: Sandstorm by the holder lasts 8 rounds instead of 5.

flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It extends the duration of the move Sandstorm when used by the holder.

flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It extends the duration of multi-turn attacks, such as Bind and Wrap.

name: choice-scarf
effect: Held: Increases Speed by 50%, but restricts the holder to only one move.
effect_full: Held: Increases the holder’s Speed by 50%, but restricts it to the first move it uses until it leaves battle or loses this item. If this item is swapped for another Choice item via Trick or Switcheroo, the holder’s restriction is still lifted, but it will again be restricted to the next move it uses. (Quirk: If the holder is switched in by U-Turn and it also knows U-Turn, U-Turn becomes its restricted move.)
flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This curious scarf boosts Speed but only allows the use of one move.

name: sticky-barb

effect_full: Held: Damaged the holder for 1/8 its max HP. When the holder is struck by a contact move, damages the attacker for 1/8 its max HP; if the attacker is not holding an item, it will take this item.
flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It damages the holder every turn and may latch on to Pokémon that touch the holder.

flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It reduces Speed but allows the holder’s Attack stat to grow more after battling.

effect_full: Held by lead Pokémon: Prevents wild battles with Pokémon that are lower level than the holder.
flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. It helps keep wild Pokémon away if the holder is the head of the party.

effect: Traded on a Rhydon: Holder evolves into Rhyperior.
effect_full: Held by Rhydon: Evolves the holder into Rhyperior when traded.
flavor: A protective item of some sort. It is extremely stiff and heavy. It’s loved by a certain Pokémon.

flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This sharply hooked claw increases the holder’s critical-hit ratio.

name: razor-fang

effect_full: Held: When the holder attacks with most damaging moves, provides an extra 11.7% (30/256) chance for the target to flinch. Held by Gligar: Evolves the holder into Gliscor when it levels up.
flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. When the holder successfully inflicts damage, the target may also flinch.

name: old-rod

name: good-rod
effect: Used to catch Pokémon in bodies of water.
effect_full: Used to find Pokémon on the Good Rod list for an area, which are generally mediocre.
flavor: A new, good-quality fishing rod. Use it at any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.

name: super-rod
effect: Used to catch Pokémon in bodies of water.
effect_full: Used to find Pokémon on the Super Rod list for an area, which are generally the best available there.
flavor: An awesome, high-tech fishing rod. Use it at any body of water to fish for wild aquatic Pokémon.

name: sprayduck

name: poffin-case

effect_full: Contains up to 100 Poffins.
flavor: A case for storing Poffins cooked from Berries.

name: bicycle
effect: Use for fast transit.

flavor: A folding Bicycle that enables a rider to get around much faster than a pair of Running Shoes will allow.

name: suite-key
effect: Opens a locked building in the Lakeside Resort.
effect_full: Opens the locked building in the lakeside resort.
flavor: A key to one of the suites at a certain luxury hotel by a lake. For some odd reason, it often disappears.

name: oaks-letter

name: lunar-wing

flavor: A card needed for entering the inn in Canalave City. Oddly, the last date marked on it was 50 years ago.

name: azure-flute

name: contest-pass

flavor: A parcel entrusted into your care. You’re supposed to deliver it to your childhood friend who left Twinleaf Town.

name: coupon-1

effect_full: One of three coupons needed to receive a Pokétch.
flavor: A coupon to be exchanged for a Pokémon Watch— Pokétch for short. Three coupons are needed.

name: coupon-2
effect: The second of three tickets used to obtain a Pokétch.

flavor: A coupon to be exchanged for a Pokémon Watch— Pokétch for short. Three coupons are needed.

flavor: A coupon to be exchanged for a Pokémon Watch— Pokétch for short. Three coupons are needed.

flavor: The key to Team Galactic’s sinister warehouse located at the edge of Veilstone City.

flavor: A glowing orb to be held by Giratina. It boosts the power of Dragon- and Ghost-type moves when it is held.

name: vs-recorder

name: gracidea

Sky Forme Shaymin will revert to Land Forme overnight, when frozen, and upon entering a link battle. This item must be used again to change it back.

name: secret-key

effect_full: Used by trainer in the Galactic Eterna Building, on the ground floor, to the left of the TV : Unlocks the secret Rotom room, in which there are five appliances which can change Rotom’s form.
flavor: A high-tech key that has to be used at a specific location. It emits a special electronic signal to open a door.

name: apricorn-box

effect_full: Stores Apricorns.
flavor: A handy box where you can store up to 99 of each kind of Apricorn.

name: berry-pots

flavor: Handy containers for cultivating Berries wherever you go.

name: squirt-bottle

effect_full: Required to water berries within the Berry Pots. Required to battle the Sudowoodo on Route 36. This item cannot be directly used from the bag.
flavor: A bottle used for watering plants in the Berry Pots.

name: lure-ball
effect: 3× effectiveness while fishing. Made from Blu Apricorn.
effect_full: Used by trainer in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost. If the wild Pokémon was encountered by fishing, the wild Pokémon’s catch rate is 3× normal.
flavor: A Poké Ball that is good for catching Pokémon that you reel in with a rod while out fishing.

name: level-ball
effect: Success rate based off of fraction target Pokémon is of user’s Pokémon. Made from Red Apricorn.
effect_full: Used by trainer in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost. If the trainer’s Pokémon’s level is higher than: * four times the wild Pokémon’s, the wild Pokémon’s catch rate is 8× normal. * than twice the wild Pokémon’s, the wild Pokémon’s catch rate is 4× normal. * the wild Pokémon’s, the wild Pokémon’s catch rate is 2× normal.
flavor: A Poké Ball that makes it easier to catch Pokémon that are at a lower level than your own Pokémon.

name: moon-ball
effect: 4× effectiveness on familes of Pokémon with a Moon Stone evolution. Made from Ylw Apricorn.
effect_full: Used by trainer in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost. If the wild Pokémon is a Clefairy, Nidoran♂, Nidoran♀, Jigglypuff, Skitty, or any evolution thereof, the wild Pokémon has 4× its catch rate.
flavor: A Poké Ball that will make it easier to catch Pokémon that can evolve using a Moon Stone.

name: heavy-ball
effect: Has flat bonus or penalty to catch rate depending on weight class of target. Made from Blk Apricorn.
effect_full: Used by a trainer in battle : Attempts to catch a wild Pokémon. If used in a trainer battle, nothing happens and the ball is lost. If the wild Pokémon weighs: * 409.6 kg (903.0 lb) or more, its catch rate is 40 more than normal. * 307.2 kg (677.3 lb) or more, its catch rate is 30 more than normal. * 204.8 kg (451.5 lb) or more, its catch rate is 20 more than normal. * less than 204.8 kg (451.5 lb), its catch rate is 20 less than normal.
flavor: A Poké Ball that is better than usual at catching very heavy Pokémon.

name: autograph

name: clothing-trunk
flavor: A very light trunk that can carry clothing for you and your Pokémon.

flavor: A Berry that makes it easier to catch Pokémon when given to them.

name: golden-razz-berry
flavor: A Berry that makes it drastically easier to catch Pokémon when given to them.

flavor: A Berry that calms wild Pokémon you’re trying to catch when given to them.

name: golden-nanab-berry

name: golden-pinap-berry

name: secret-key--letsgo
flavor: The key that unlocks the front door of the Pokémon Gym on Cinnabar Island. It has a red decoration.

name: ss-ticket--letsgo
flavor: The ticket required to board the S.S. Anne. It has a drawing of a ship on it.

name: parcel--letsgo
flavor: A parcel to be delivered to Professor Oak from Viridian City’s Poké Mart.

name: card-key--letsgo
flavor: A card key that unlocks doors in Silph Co.’s head office in Saffron City.

name: stretchy-spring

name: chalky-stone
flavor: A small whitish stone picked up at the edge of the road.

name: marble
flavor: A round glass marble. You can see colored glass inside the transparent marble.

name: lone-earring
flavor: A single earring that somebody dropped.

name: beach-glass

name: gold-leaf

name: silver-leaf
flavor: A mysterious silver leaf. No trees with this leaf have been found yet.

name: polished-mud-ball

name: tropical-shell

name: leaf-letter--eevee

name: small-bouquet

flavor: A glass bottle of perfume that makes rare Pokémon more likely to appear. It lasts longer than a Super Lure.

name: endorsement
flavor: A letter of recommendation that you’ll need in order to participate in the Gym Challenge.

name: pokemon-box-link
flavor: A device that allows you to access the Pokémon storage system. There are some places where it won’t work.

name: wishing-star
flavor: A stone found in the Galar region with a mysterious power. It’s said that your dreams come true if you find one.

name: dynamax-band
flavor: A Wishing Star has been affixed to it. It lets out a light that allows Pokémon to Dynamax when at a Power Spot.

name: fishing-rod--galar
flavor: Use it by the water to fish up various kinds of Pokémon.

name: rotom-bike
flavor: This bike can be combined with the Pokémon Rotom to use a turbo boost.

name: sausages
flavor: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. These sausages should be boiled before eating.

name: bobs-food-tin
flavor: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. The tinned food that Bob sells is curiously popular in Galar.

name: bachs-food-tin
flavor: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. The tinned food that Bach sells is curiously popular in Galar.

name: tin-of-beans
flavor: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. When simmered, the beans suffuse a dish with their mild flavor.

name: bread
flavor: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. An indispensable tool for mopping up that extra curry left on your plate.

name: pasta
flavor: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. These flour noodles make for a surprisingly good match with curry.

name: mixed-mushrooms
flavor: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. The chewy texture of the mushrooms transforms any dish they’re added to.

name: smoke-poke-tail
flavor: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. When a Slowpoke’s tail falls off, it grows back quickly.

name: large-leek
flavor: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. Whether this is the kind of vegetable stalk that Farfetch’d like is unknown.

name: fancy-apple
flavor: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. An apple chosen above others. It has spectacular form and a brilliant sheen.

name: brittle-bones
flavor: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. The taste boiled off from the bones is sure to give a dish a light umami taste.

name: pack-of-potatoes
flavor: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. Potatoes help mellow out a spicy taste, to make a dish more mild.

name: pungent-root
flavor: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. Though carelessly picked, these herbs can add a fragrant accent to a dish.

name: salad-mix
flavor: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. The assortment of vegetables looks quite appealing and healthy.

name: fried-food
flavor: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. It’s been a while since it was fried, so it’s gotten greasy.

name: boiled-egg
flavor: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. Even just one boiled egg can really enhance a dish.

name: camping-gear
flavor: Everything you need to set up a tent and get cooking in a Wild Area or at a camping spot.

name: rusted-sword
flavor: It is said that a hero used this sword to halt a terrible disaster in ancient times. But it’s grown rusty and worn.

name: rusted-shield
flavor: It is said that a hero used this shield to halt a terrible disaster in ancient times. But it’s grown rusty and worn.

name: fossilized-bird
flavor: The fossil of an ancient Pokémon that once soared through the sky. What it looked like is a mystery.

name: fossilized-fish
flavor: The fossil of an ancient Pokémon that once lived in the sea. What it looked like is a mystery.

name: fossilized-drake
flavor: The fossil of an ancient Pokémon that once roamed the land. What it looked like is a mystery.

name: fossilized-dino
flavor: The fossil of an ancient Pokémon that once lived in the sea. What it looked like is a mystery.

name: strawberry-sweet
flavor: A strawberry-shaped sweet. When a Milcery holds this, it will spin around happily.

name: love-sweet
flavor: A heart-shaped sweet. When a Milcery holds this, it spins around happily.

name: berry-sweet
flavor: A berry-shaped sweet. When a Milcery holds this, it spins around happily.

name: clover-sweet
flavor: A clover-shaped sweet. When a Milcery holds this, it spins around happily.

name: flower-sweet
flavor: A flower-shaped sweet. When a Milcery holds this, it spins around happily.

name: star-sweet
flavor: A star-shaped sweet. When a Milcery holds this, it spins around happily.

name: ribbon-sweet
flavor: A ribbon-shaped sweet. When a Milcery holds this, it spins around happily.

name: sweet-apple
flavor: A peculiar apple that can make a certain species of Pokémon evolve. It’s exceptionally sweet.

name: tart-apple
flavor: A peculiar apple that can make a certain species of Pokémon evolve. It’s exceptionally tart.

name: throat-spray
flavor: Raises Sp. Atk when a Pokémon uses a sound-based move.

name: eject-pack
flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. When the holder’s stats are lowered, it will be switched out of battle.

name: heavy-duty-boots
flavor: These boots prevent the effects of traps set on the battlefield.

name: blunder-policy
flavor: Raises Speed sharply when a Pokémon misses with a move because of accuracy.

name: room-service
flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. Lowers Speed when Trick Room takes effect.

name: utility-umbrella
flavor: An item to be held by a Pokémon. This sturdy umbrella protects the holder from the effects of rain and harsh sunlight.

name: exp-candy-xs
flavor: A candy that is packed with energy. When consumed, it will grant a single Pokémon a very small amount of Exp. Points.

name: exp-candy-s
flavor: A candy that is packed with energy. When consumed, it will grant a single Pokémon a small amount of Exp. Points.

name: exp-candy-m
flavor: A candy that is packed with energy. When consumed, it will grant a single Pokémon a moderate amount of Exp. Points.

name: exp-candy-l
flavor: A candy that is packed with energy. When consumed, it will grant a single Pokémon a large amount of Exp. Points.

name: exp-candy-xl
flavor: A candy that is packed with energy. When consumed, it will grant a single Pokémon a very large amount of Exp. Points.

name: dynamax-candy
flavor: A candy that is packed with energy. When consumed, it will raise the Dynamax Level of a single Pokémon by one. A higher level means higher HP when Dynamaxed.

name: tr00
flavor: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This sharply raises the user’s Attack stat.

name: tr01
flavor: The user drops onto the target with its full body weight. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

name: tr02
flavor: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.

name: tr03
flavor: The target is blasted by a huge volume of water launched under great pressure.

name: tr04
flavor: The user attacks everything around it by swamping its surroundings with a giant wave.

name: tr05
flavor: The target is struck with an icy-cold beam of energy. This may also leave the target frozen.

name: tr06
flavor: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike opposing Pokémon. This may also leave the opposing Pokémon frozen.

name: tr07
flavor: A powerful low kick that makes the target fall over. The heavier the target, the greater the move’s power.

name: tr08
flavor: A strong electric blast crashes down on the target. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

name: tr09
flavor: A wicked thunderbolt is dropped on the target to inflict damage. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

name: tr10
flavor: The user sets off an earthquake that strikes every Pokémon around it.

name: tr11
flavor: The target is hit by a strong telekinetic force. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.

name: tr12
flavor: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply raises the Speed stat.

name: tr13
flavor: The user takes a deep breath and focuses so that critical hits land more easily.

name: tr14
flavor: The user waggles a finger and stimulates its brain into randomly using nearly any move.

name: tr15
flavor: The target is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.

name: tr16
flavor: The user charges at the target and may make it flinch.

name: tr17
flavor: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. This sharply raises the user’s Sp. Def stat.

name: tr18
flavor: The user drains the target’s blood. The user’s HP is restored by half the damage taken by the target.

name: tr19
flavor: The user strikes with a simultaneous three-beam attack. This may also burn, freeze, or paralyze the target.

name: tr20
flavor: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its HP. The substitute serves as the user’s decoy.

name: tr21
flavor: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.

name: tr22
flavor: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. This may also poison the target.

name: tr23
flavor: The user lays a trap of spikes at the opposing team’s feet. The trap hurts Pokémon that switch into battle.

name: tr24
flavor: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.

name: tr25
flavor: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This attack does physical damage.

name: tr26
flavor: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

name: tr27
flavor: While it is asleep, the user randomly uses one of the moves it knows.

name: tr28
flavor: Using its tough and impressive horn, the user rams into the target with no letup.

name: tr29
flavor: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting and passes along any stat changes.

name: tr30
flavor: The user compels the target to keep using the move it encored for three turns.

name: tr31

flavor: Strange earbuds that allow you to freely control the volume of various sounds.

name: fruit-bunch
flavor: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. The syrupy fruits give off a strong tropical feel.

name: moomoo-cheese
flavor: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. Melted cheese can really give a curry some richness.

name: spice-mix
flavor: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. There are over fifty spices contained within this ingredient’s hot flavor.

name: fresh-cream
flavor: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. Add some whipped cream to a spicy curry to give it some sweetness.

name: packaged-curry
flavor: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. Using packaged curry helps make sure there are no slipups when cooking.

name: coconut-milk
flavor: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. The refined sweetness of this coconut milk makes it quite popular.

name: instant-noodles
flavor: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. It has a junk-food sort of taste, but it goes well with curry.

name: precooked-burger
flavor: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. If you’re unsure about what to cook, you can’t go wrong with some burger.

name: gigantamix
flavor: One of the many ingredients that can be used for cooking at your camp. A mysterious spice. Even a tiny sprinkle is sure to make a curry gigantic.

name: wishing-chip
flavor: Toss a number of them into a Pokémon Den for the chance to attract a wild Dynamax Pokémon.

name: rotom-bike--water-mode
flavor: This bike can be combined with the Pokémon Rotom to not only do a turbo boost but also run on the water.

name: catching-charm
flavor: Holding it is said to increase the chance of getting a critical catch. Curiously, the charm doesn’t shake much.

name: old-letter
flavor: A letter entrusted to you by a girl, to be delivered to a boy. Strangely, it looks old to you.

name: band-autograph
flavor: It’s signed by all members of the Galar region’s most charismatic band, the Maximizers.

name: sonias-book
flavor: Professor Sonia’s published writings. Her new discoveries about the Galar region’s legends are recorded in this enjoyable read.

name: rotom-catalog
flavor: A catalog of devices that Rotom like. Use the catalog to have Rotom hop in and out of the various devices listed within.

name: max-honey
flavor: Honey that Dynamax Vespiquen produces. Adding this honey to Max Soup makes the taste very smooth. It also has the same effect as a Max Revive.

name: max-mushrooms
flavor: Mushrooms that have the power of changing Dynamax forms. They boost all stats of a Pokémon during battle.

name: galarica-twig
flavor: A twig from a species of tree called Galarica that grows in certain areas around the Galar region. It’s a material for an accessory for a certain Pokémon.

name: galarica-cuff
flavor: A cuff made from woven-together Galarica Twigs. Giving it to Galarian Slowpoke makes the Pokémon very happy.

name: style-card
flavor: A card that increases the selection in boutiques and hair salons.

name: armor-pass
flavor: A pass to go to the Isle of Armor. Show it to the rail staff at Wedgehurst Station.

name: rotom-bike--sparkling-white
flavor: This bike can do a turbo boost and run on the water using Rotom’s power. It’s a sparkling white that shines brilliantly.

name: rotom-bike--glistening-black
flavor: This bike can do a turbo boost and run on the water using Rotom’s power. It’s a glistening black that shines reddish-black.

name: exp-charm
flavor: A charm that increases the Exp. Points that Pokémon can get. A machine-like object is inside the charm.

name: armorite-ore
flavor: Rare ore that can be obtained on the Isle of Armor. Something good will happen if you give it to a collector on the Isle of Armor.

name: mark-charm
flavor: A mysterious and unique charm that increases the chance of finding a Pokémon with a mark.

name: reins-of-unity--merge
flavor: Reins that people presented to the king. They enhance Calyrex’s power over bountiful harvests and unite Calyrex with its beloved steed.

name: reins-of-unity--split
flavor: Reins that people presented to the king. They enable those who are connected to communicate with each other. The reins separate Calyrex and its beloved steed.

name: galarica-wreath
flavor: A wreath made from woven-together Galarica Twigs. Placing it on the head of a Galarian Slowpoke makes the Pokémon very happy.

name: legendary-clue-1
flavor: A clue about the King of Bountiful Harvests. It’s written by Peony, and an old photo is attached to it.

name: legendary-clue-2
flavor: A clue about the legend of giants. It’s written by Peony and has unique drawings.

name: legendary-clue-3
flavor: A clue about the legend of bird Pokémon. It’s written by Peony and has a unique drawing.

name: legendary-clue-question
flavor: A mysterious clue that Peony seems to have dropped. There’s a photo attached to it showing a shining hole opening above the Max Lair.

name: crown-pass
flavor: A pass to go to the Crown Tundra. Show it to the rail staff at Wedgehurst Station.

name: wooden-crown
flavor: A mysterious object made of wood. Part of it seems to be chipped. Maybe it’s meant to be part of something.

name: radiant-petal
flavor: A single petal that the King of Bountiful Harvests gave you. It radiates faint light.

name: white-mane-hair
flavor: Mane hair that belonged to the King of Bountiful Harvests’ beloved steed, Glastrier. The hair is strong and very flexible.

name: black-mane-hair
flavor: Mane hair that belonged to the King of Bountiful Harvests’ beloved steed, Spectrier. The hair is very smooth to the touch.

name: iceroot-carrot
flavor: Produce that the King of Bountiful Harvests’ beloved steed likes to eat. It grew in a field covered in snow.

name: shaderoot-carrot
flavor: Produce that the King of Bountiful Harvests’ beloved steed likes to eat. It grew in a gloomy field.

name: dynite-ore
flavor: Mysterious ore that can be obtained in the Max Lair. Something good will happen if you give it to a collector in the Crown Tundra.

name: carrot-seeds
flavor: Seeds to plant in a field. The kind of carrot you’ll get is determined by which field you plant the seeds in.

name: ability-patch
flavor: A patch that allows a Pokémon with a regular Ability to have a rare Ability.

name: reins-of-unity
flavor: Cords that shine when you hold them up to the light. The people of old times presented these to the King of Bountiful Harvests to express their gratitude.

name: linking-cord
effect: Allows a Pokemon whose evolution is usually triggered by trading to evolve
effect_full: The Linking Cord triggers the evolution of certain Pokémon (all of which can alternatively evolve when traded) upon use. This consumes the Linking Cord.

name: laheavy-ball
flavor: Doesn't fly far, but is more effective if the Pokémon hasn't noticed the player.

name: laleaden-ball
flavor: Upgraded version of the Heavy Ball. Doesn't fly far, but is more effective if the Pokémon hasn't noticed the player.

name: lagigaton-ball
flavor: Upgraded version of the Leaden Ball. Doesn't fly far, but is more effective if the Pokémon hasn't noticed the player.

name: lafeather-ball
flavor: Can be thrown further than a regular Poké Ball. Is more effective for catching Pokémon that fly high in the air.

name: lawing-ball
flavor: Can be thrown further than a Feather Ball. Is more effective for catching Pokémon that fly high in the air.

name: lajet-ball
flavor: Can be thrown further than a Wing Ball. Is more effective for catching Pokémon that fly high in the air.
